name: Well Read
effect: When you draw any number of cards, draw 1 more.

name: Deep Inkwell
effect: Whenever you gain ink, gain 2 more.

name: Effortless Twists
effect: Each of your Twists costs -1 ink.

name: Hidden Strength
effect: When played during a conflict, your Subplots give +2 power.

name: An Unlikely Companion
effect: Gain a new character from the deck.

name: Strength in the Margins
effect: Each of your overflow Inklings has +2 power.

name: Command the Page
effect: Each of your Inklings on page spaces has +2 power.

name: Double Take
effect: During conflict, each inkling allows you to play 2 cards.

name: Make Room
effect: When placing an inkling onto a page space, you may first move an opponent's inkling from that space to the overflow.

name: Ink in the Margins
effect: At the end of a conflict, if you lost, gain 2 ink per Inkling you had there.
